card.title: SEABORNE INVASION
card.text: All enemy units in the frontline retreat. Add two US infantry units there with total attack of 6.
card.flavorText: Many seaborne invasions were carried out by the Allied forces during WWII, but perhaps the most famous and largest seaborne invasion in history was the Allied landings in Normandy on June 6, 1944 (D-Day). The target was a 80 kilometer stretch of the Normandy coast which was defended by the German forces. In total the Allies deployed around 156,000 troops in Normandy on D-Day, 73,000 American, 61,715 British, 21,400 Canadian, the rest came from Australia, Belgium, Czechoslovakia, Denmark, France, Greece, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway and Poland. The invasion ended with Allied victory and by June 11th 54,186 troops, 104,428 vehicles and 547,428 tonnes of supplies had been landed on the beaches.
